title: Polynomial-time equality test against a fixed word
statement: Let $f$ be a polynomial-time computable function from binary strings to binary strings, and let $w$ be a fixed binary word. Then the function that returns the one-bit word recording whether $f(x)=w$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a polynomial-time computable function on binary strings
replaced:
Let $f$ be a polynomial-time computable function on binary strings and $w$ a
fixed word. Then the single-bit function testing whether $f(x) = w$ is
polynomial-time computable.
